name: Newborn Moments: Baby Photo AI
subtitle: Dreamy Studio Portraits & More
promotionalText: New dreamy themes added! Turn one snapshot into a magical studio portrait of your baby in seconds — no editing skills needed.
description:
Turn a single photo of your baby into a beautiful, AI-generated studio portrait — no camera gear, no appointment, no editing skills required.

Newborn Moments creates dozens of dreamy, professional-style portraits from one snapshot: soft studio lighting, whimsical costumes, and imaginative scenes your baby has never actually been in. Astronaut, fairy, tiny chef, and many more — a brand-new look every time.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Generate studio-quality AI portraits in seconds
• Explore dozens of ready-made themes, or describe your own idea
• Track every milestone — first smile, first steps, first tooth — in one organized place
• Turn a list of milestones into a beautiful collage video, with optional music
• Save every portrait and collage to your gallery to revisit anytime

Why families love it
No studio visit, no professional photographer, no fuss — just upload a clear photo and watch it become something magical. Every portrait is generated fresh, so no two are ever quite the same.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, managed from your device's App Store settings.
